first_failure_chain: Wyvern deployed at 330 and blocked #2 at 656; the declared BLOCK prediction was verified.
Wyvern took physical damage from #2 at 700, 732, and 764.
#2 leaked at 986, before the next planned structure could restore the route.
The 1650 Wyvern skill and 1652 Ansel deploy depended on Wyvern being alive; Wyvern was dead and Ansel lacked the static-assumed skill income.

causal_interpretation: The first failure was not command syntax. It was an unsupported survival/economic dependency: a later skill income and deploy assumed the early blocker remained alive, while it died before that dependency arrived. Rationale text could not preserve the dependency.

Do not count skill income from an operator already dead at runtime; support DP assumptions with living skill timing or stable natural/retreat income.
Replace fixed conditional-rationale retreats with runtime-supported timing and living replacement coverage.
